November 20, 1958

Mr. James J. Houlahan
President
William Esty Company, Inc.
100 East 42nd Street
New York 17, New York

Dear Jim:

Thanks so much for yours of the nineteenth and for the clippings on the air pollution story. Perhaps you have heard also that Dr. Burney was on this morning's TV show -- "Today" -- with about the same sort of talk. I understand that there was only one small reference to cigarettes in the program.

All good wishes.

Sincerely,

Bowman Gray
